calibration.note: margin(top1-top2) threshold 0.05 from 293-event batch: correct p50=0.093, wrong p50=0.048. Quality-score gate removed (no discriminative power: 39/63 wrong cases scored >=80). Raw similarity threshold not used (wrong-case median 0.501 overlaps correct-case distribution).

geographicPrior.note: Hard local-species filter (2026-11-25): when the device supplies a valid WGS84 location inside coverage (China + North America, 473 cells, eBird/GBIF-derived), BioCLIP similarity for species without support in the containing 3-degree cell is suppressed, so Top5 only ranks the local avifauna. Outside coverage, missing location, or pool < minPoolSpecies falls back to the full taxonomy (neutral). Only valid when the photographed bird is physically at the device location; screen/remote-stream imagery must not send location.

openSetEscape.note: Single call per event. When the review model is confident and the visible evidence contradicts every supplied candidate, it may name one species outside the shortlist (outsideCandidates); the program resolves that name against AviList and only then returns it, with confidence capped at proposalConfidenceCap. With proposalOverrideCandidate the proposal may also replace a first-pass candidate when it names that candidate's rank as contradicted, carries at least proposalOverrideMinEvidence visible evidence, and shares the candidate's family; confidence is then capped at proposalOverrideConfidenceCap. When the hard geographic filter restricted the candidate pool, the model still sees the device coordinates and may bypass the filter with a non-local species if it provides at least proposalGeoBypassMinEvidence visible evidence; the decision is audited as geoFilterBypassed. Candidate-pool escapes and API contract are otherwise unchanged.

multiFrame.note: Three consecutive frames of one camera event; candidates fused by score_mean, all three images sent to Doubao.

audio.note: Standalone audio service (api/bird_audio_service.py, port 8001). Image pipeline does not read audio. Noise gate uses YAMNet (human/pet/vehicle/wind/media) plus spectral checks.

textOverrides.note: v5 Tier A/B/C/D text overrides; review traits only, retrieval geometry unchanged.
